decisions.rationale: SITE_PID 555729583 already owns feature_id 15378 in the October baseline (Bonden, Sweden; Natura 2000 SCI). The maintainer explicitly reviewed the November ambiguity and approved preserving continuity for that existing key while its source geometry and properties change. The newly matching geometry belongs to distinct existing Bonden designations: feature_id 11347 (Birds Directive) and 15093 (Habitats Directive). Keep 15378 for its existing key; reusing either matched ID would merge distinct records, while assigning a new ID would deliberately abandon the existing identity.
